2607.25659.title: CoRT: Counterfactual Replay for Token-Level Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization
2607.25659.paper_summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning enriches language model training by evaluating model outputs against explicit criteria. Yet in GRPO-style pipelines, these structured judgments are reduced to a scalar response-level reward and converted into a response-level advantage, which is broadcast uniformly to all generated tokens. This leaves no explicit mechanism for allocating credit within a response, even when different criteria are grounded in different spans, formatting decisions, or semantic choices. We propose CoRT, a token-level credit weighting method for rubric-conditioned GRPO. Instead of training an auxiliary token scoring model, CoRT uses counterfactual replay to rescore the same sampled response under the original rubric-conditioned prompt and a matched criteria-free prompt. The resulting tokenwise log-likelihood contrasts serve as a proxy for dependence on the rubric context. CoRT maps these contrasts to bounded, response-normalized weights and uses them to redistribute the signed GRPO advantage across tokens, without introducing an auxiliary scorer or changing the response-level reward. Experiments across instruction-tuned models and reward granularities show that CoRT improves over matched response-level GRPO in the vast majority of comparisons, with an average gain of 4.4 percentage points. The method remains competitive with learned token-level credit baselines while avoiding a separate relevance-learning stage. These results suggest that policy-internal counterfactual likelihood contrasts provide an effective training signal for within-response credit allocation while retaining the simplicity and stability of GRPO.
2607.25659.paper_summary_zh: 基於評分標準的強化學習通過根據明確標準評估模型輸出來豐富語言模型的訓練。<lb/>然而，在GRPO風格的管道中，這些結構化的判斷被簡化為標量響應級別的獎勵，並轉換為響應級別的優勢，這一優勢均勻地廣播到所有生成的標記。<lb/>這使得在響應內部分配信用的明確機制消失，即使不同的標準基於不同的範圍、格式決策或語義選擇。我們提出了CoRT，一種針對基於評分標準的GRPO的標記級信用加權方法。<lb/>CoRT不是訓練輔助的標記評分模型，而是利用反事實重播在原始的基於評分標準的提示和匹配的無標準提示下重新評分相同的抽樣響應。<lb/>生成的逐標記對數似然對比作為對評分標準上下文依賴性的代理。<lb/>CoRT將這些對比映射到有界的、響應標準化的權重，並用它們來在標記之間重新分配簽名的GRPO優勢，而不引入輔助評分者或改變響應級別的獎勵。<lb/>在指令調整模型和獎勵細分的實驗中顯示，CoRT在絕大多數比較中優於匹配的響應級別GRPO，平均增益為4.4個百分點。<lb/>該方法在避免單獨的相關性學習階段的同時，仍然與學習的標記級信用基準保持競爭力。<lb/>這些結果表明，政策內部的反事實似然對比為響應內部的信用分配提供了有效的訓練信號，同時保持了GRPO的簡單性和穩定性。
